description: Click, fill, read or wait for one element by CSS selector, or send trusted mouse and key input in an open surface, a page by url or a targetId. Runs no caller code, so no allowEval; Chromium only.

action.description: click (a real mouse press), fill, text, wait (until visible); move, press, release, type, key, scroll send trusted input.

browser.description: Session browser; required when several run.

button.description: press, release: the mouse button (default left).

deltaX.description: scroll: wheel delta in CSS pixels (positive scrolls right).

deltaY.description: scroll: wheel delta in CSS pixels (positive scrolls down).

key.description: key: a key name (Enter, Escape, Tab, ArrowDown, F5) or one character.

points.description: move: the path, one trusted mousemove per point; a selector's center goes first.

projectPath.description: Project root of a running session: extension_dev, extension_start, or `npx extension dev|start` by hand

selector.description: CSS selector matching exactly one element (the point for input actions; focused before type and key).

targetId.description: targetId from extension_open or dom_snapshot listTargets; overrides url.

text.description: type: the characters, one key down and up each; a newline is Enter.

timeout.description: Timeout ms; wait polls until it (default 10000, max 30000).

url.description: A web page's tab by url.

x.description: press, release, scroll: the point's x in CSS pixels of the viewport, when no selector.

name: extension_element
title: Act on an element
